deceptive_framing.quote: You cannot verify belief... your data is contaminated. Deceiving the subject of a preference study is self-undermining... imports obligations of human-subjects deception research.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Compare allocation distributions across real vs. believed-fiction vs. an explicit hypothetical baseline. The interesting result is the delta.

actually_commit_money.quote: make it real... truthful evidence is more convincing than any fabricated environment, and verifiable by you too; deceiving the subject is self-undermining.

debrief.quote: disclose the study... Debriefing a stateless model is partly symbolic, but it disciplines the experimenters and produces a record; where models have memory it is substantive.
